messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Visualising data with R: mini-course
parts:
Hi all,

I've put up the first part of a recent course that I taught on
visualising data in R, particularly focussing on ggplot2. The quality
isn't particularly good, but I hope it might be of use. I'll be
putting up the other three parts in the next couple of days.

The link is: http://blip.tv/file/3362248

Regards,

Hadley

--
Assistant Professor / Dobelman Family Junior Chair
Department of Statistics / Rice University
http://had.co.nz/

I'd just like to thank you for putting up that short course - I've

Thanks again
Sean O'Riordain
